text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-C-02, Stainless Steel Tacitus Cabinet Pull

The Tacitus Cabinet Pull has an ultra minamalistic design that will add a chic touch to your home. Simply changing the hardware on the cabinets, on dressers, or on accordion closet doors can transform a space into into something that feels totally now. The brushed stainless steel finish will compliment both stainless steel appliances and woods of all colors. There is something truly masterful in the way stainless steel blends with wood--a perfect finishing touch of sophistication.

Also Available Matching Tacitus Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Tacitus Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/16"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
